photo of my cat around diwali last year

questions.q: Task 2, the dog by a tree from the Diwali before that: how did it go?

options.option: I found it and I'm sure it's the right one

questions.q: Did you use any of these in the prototype?

options.option: Picked a suggested alternative (like "or Diwali 2024")
Removed or changed a clue (the small labels showing what it understood, like "Diwali 2025")
"Around that time" (moving to nearby months)
"Why this moment?"

questions.q: Which of those helped most, or confused you?

answers.text: The year label was wrong and couldn't be fixed
Seeing the photos around it helped
Moving to nearby months, like scrolling but faster

questions.q: For Task 1, how sure are you that you picked the right photo?
What made you sure, or not sure?
In your own words, what did the prototype do with what you typed? Did it get anything wrong?

answers.text: Got "last year" right, "the year before last" wrong
Turned one word into an event and a date
It was the right event and the right month

questions.q: Compared with searching Google Photos, finding a photo with the prototype was…
What could the prototype do that Google Photos can't? And what does Google Photos do better?

answers.text: Understands festivals plus "last year" / Google Photos has real photos and faces
Shows the moment, not a grid / Google Photos is faster for simple searches
Works without knowing what to type / Google Photos has albums
Find the exact month and the year that I was searching. And it could understand the mix of hindi and english language

questions.q: If you could change one thing about the prototype, what would it be?

answers.text: Show the date range more clearly
Make the clue labels more obvious
The Design and the speed at which the photos are retrieved
Better looking and photo retrieval speed

questions.q: If Google Photos worked like this, when would you use it?

options.option: Every time I look for an old photo
Only when normal search doesn't work
